# Changelog

## 0.1.0

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation of `polynom` 1.4-1.
- Added typed polynomial and polylist representations.
- Added arithmetic, calculus, interpolation, roots, GCD/LCM, summaries,
  orthogonal polynomials, coefficient transformations, tests, and examples.
- Preserved GPL-2.0-only licensing and complete upstream provenance.
